Confirmed active technical insulation and structural building materials wholesale distributor. They offer fire protection sealants under partner brands and their own 'wegoprotect' brand, acting as a distributor/reseller in this market segment.

Acquired by STARK Deutschland / Raab Karcher. It no longer trades entirely independently (integrated into Raab Karcher platform), but the local branches remain active under the group. It is a specialist trader distributing multi-brand passive fire protection sealants.
Active B2B technical wholesaler distributing multi-brand preventive fire protection systems, including third-party fire protection joint sealants (e.g., from Armacell, Zapp-Zimmermann).
Active independent wholesale distributor supplying multi-brand technical insulation, drywall, and specialty construction products including firestop sealants to the trade.
Active specialized trade wholesaler focused on elastic sealants, professional adhesives, and fire protection silicone/acrylic joint sealants manufactured by third-party brands.

Active technical distributor and specialized B2B wholesaler supplying professional adhesives, hybrid joint sealants, and firestop silicone/acrylic compounds from various manufacturers (e.g., Otto Chemie, Soudal).

Active full-range industrial technical wholesaler distributing chemical-technical materials, including professional high-temperature silicone and fire-retardant acrylic joint sealants made by others (e.g., Soudal, Sika).
Active B2B hardware and technical building supplies wholesale distributor that restocks and sells fire-rated expanding foams, hybrid compounds, and firestop joint sealants from major external brands.
